Round 187 (STORE-1b) is implemented. It now waits for C; nothing was committed or pushed.

**What changed** (only the 3 granted files and the 2 new files; `git status` shows 3 ` M` and 2 `??`, and the 1010-file frozen list still matches):
- **K1 (player fill):** in `AudioPlayer.tsx`, `var(--color-primary)` is now `var(--color-brand)`, 4 replacements on 2 lines. The played part of the progress bar and the set part of the volume slider now show teal; before, they were not drawn at all.
- **K2 (button flip):** `AudioPreviewButton.tsx` no longer has the `isClient` check, so the server and the browser render the same working button from the start. Both buttons now have `type="button"`. The props (`track`, `variant`) are unchanged.
- **K3:** two lines in doc 153: status is `Completed`, and the line about C round 186 now says it passed and was published as `cc207d6`.
- **T1:** new test file `app/lib/__tests__/audio-preview-player.test.tsx` with 14 tests covering B1–B4 and P1–P3. Two of them were added after the code review and check hydration inside the real `AudioProvider`.
- **D1:** new Georgian doc 154, covering ruling R55 and the alternative B rejected.

**Checks I ran:**
- **Before/after on T1:** I put B's start copies in place of my 2 code files for one run, then restored my versions and confirmed the hashes. On the old code 10 of 14 tests fail: B1, the B4 DOM check and P1, as required. The remaining 4 pass because they guard behaviour that should not change.
- **Targeted tests:** 34 of 34 pass across the 3 files. Typecheck and lint exit 0.
- **Biome on my files:** 0 errors and 5 warnings. All 5 are older missing `type` warnings on the other player buttons, which K1 told me not to touch.
- **Server-rendered HTML:** the "Preview" label class appears 0 times on `/products/middle-east`, `/` and `/store`. I checked again after the file swaps and the shared server shows my final code.
- **Browser, Playwright at 1440:** after clicking Play preview, the brand colour (it resolves to `rgb(18, 217, 200)`) appears in both the progress and volume backgrounds. The button label switched to "Pause preview", with 0 page errors, 0 hydration messages and no outside requests except Google Fonts. The screenshot `a-round-187/player-bar-1440.png` shows teal on both tracks.
- The mock API on :5199 wasn't running, so I started it and stopped it again at the end.

**The task text is wrong about `/store`:** that page has no preview buttons, because `store.tsx` doesn't use `ProductCard` or the preview button. So the `/store` parts of C's FLIP-187 and PREVIEW-187 can't run as written; the card buttons only exist on `/`. I put this in the report so C records it as a fact rather than a failure.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent found no Critical or High issues. I fixed its Medium finding by adding the real-provider tests. Two points I left for B to decide, because B's task requires the current form:
- P2 checks that `--color-primary` is defined nowhere. That test will break if the redesign adds that colour on purpose.
- P1 wraps the player in `MemoryRouter` from `react-router-dom`, which the project only gets through Remix and doesn't list itself.

The reviewer's Architecture note is copied word for word in the report. It suggested the real-provider hydration test, which is now in T1.

**Open issues for B:** `ProductCard.tsx:141` uses `bg-primary` / `text-primary-foreground`, which point to colours that don't exist, the same kind of bug as K1 but in a file I may not touch. The other leftovers are the older warnings, the hardcoded unfilled-track colour and the now-unused `.audio-preview-overlay-text` style. I didn't run the full test suite, the build or verify; those are the root gate's job.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; open `a-round-187.md` first.
